display.purpose: Single-message full pages (the portal error state).

headline.purpose: The page h1: Your agenda, Sign in to speak with us.

card-title.purpose: The talk title on the agenda card and the empty-year card's line.

badge-name.purpose: The speaker name on the badge (a paragraph, not a heading).

agenda-heading.purpose: The Saved talks heading and the Needs you strip's heading.

row-title.purpose: A talk title in a saved-talk row or the Needs you strip.

body-small.purpose: Secondary lines, notes, the badge bio.

label.purpose: Form labels and legends, sentence case.

hint.purpose: Hints (white 50%) and field errors (Red 300) under the field.

data-small.purpose: Ruler month labels, step dates, pill dates.

shadows.name: badge-hang
shadows.purpose: The speaker badge and sign-in badge only.

shadows.name: punched-slot
shadows.purpose: The slot cut into the top of a badge.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: The admin's More menus and the dropdown's open list, which float over the content they belong to.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The one curve for every portal transition (--ease-settle in globals.css).

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Portal page content arriving; the header stays put.

motion.name: row-in
motion.value: 450ms, translateY(10px), stagger 45ms per row after 120ms, capped at 6
motion.purpose: Saved-talk rows and the Needs you strip arriving.

motion.name: ruler-draw
motion.value: 600ms after 150ms, scaleY(0) to 1 from the foot
motion.purpose: The year ruler's today line arriving.

motion.name: marker-pop
motion.value: 500ms, scale(0.4) and fade, stagger 70ms per marker after 450ms, capped at 6
motion.purpose: Ruler markers arriving after the today line.

motion.name: stage-morph
motion.value: view transition agenda-stage: group 450ms ease-settle; old fades out 180ms ease-out; new fades in 320ms after 80ms
motion.purpose: The agenda card switching talks, or turning into a form and back. Skipped without view transitions or under reduced motion.

motion.name: panel-close
motion.purpose: The saved-talk editor closing, quicker than opening.

motion.name: badge-swing
motion.value: 1150ms damped pendulum from translateY(-28px) rotate(-10deg) to rest at -1.2deg
motion.purpose: Once per visit, the first badge.

motion.name: badge-arrive
motion.purpose: Later loads, second badges, the sign-in badge.

motion.name: badge-tilt
motion.purpose: Fine pointers only, never on a badge holding a form.

motion.name: select-list-in
motion.value: 180ms ease-settle, fade and 4px toward the field
motion.purpose: The dropdown's open list arriving (.select-list in globals.css); down from above when it opens below the field, up when above.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no swing, tilt, travel, stagger, ruler draw, marker pop, stage morph or press; all durations 0.01ms

narrative.northStar: The Badge You'll Wear on the Day
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Badge You'll Wear on the Day"**

The back office lives on the same dark Black 02 page as gdgsydney.com, so a speaker arriving from `/speak` never feels they have left. Its signature is the speaker portal's badge: the speaker's public profile drawn as a lanyard badge, striped strap and all, with their speaking year beside it: a ruler from six months back to six ahead, today in the middle, over one large card for the talk that matters now. Everything else is quiet on purpose. Flat opaque grey surfaces, pill buttons, sentence-case labels and one bright stripe of the four Google core colours do the brand work, and the content carries the rest.

Density is low and the reading is fast: a returning speaker visiting twice a year should see their badge, what needs them, and what is next on the first phone screen. Colour is functional before it is decorative. Green means something is in or waiting on you, yellow means it is being read, blue is the action, and quiet white means it is over. The motion has one curve, an exponential ease-out that arrives confidently and settles, and it all falls away for people who prefer reduced motion.

BRANDING.md is the authority on the palette, the contrast variants, the surface treatment and the interactive-state rules. This file records how the shipped build applies them.
keyCharacteristics: Dark Black 02 page with opaque `#282828` and `#303030` surfaces, no translucent cards.
Google Sans for everything people read; Google Sans Mono only for dates, times and short data labels.
Pill buttons throughout; solid fills only in the deep contrast variants.
The speaker badge on its GDG lanyard as the one signature object, with the year ruler and its agenda card as its companion.
A single ease curve, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, for every portal transition.

rules.name: The Deep Fill Rule
rules.body: A solid button with white text is always a deep variant (Blue 700, Green 700, Red 600). The core colours stay for accents, outlines, tints and text.

rules.name: The Status Colour Rule
rules.body: In the agenda, colour is the status, the same on the ruler marker, the pill, the card's status line and its current step: green for to confirm, confirmed or coming up, yellow for under review, white (60% text, 40% dot) for given, not selected or passed. Words always say the same thing; colour is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Four Colours, Once Rule
rules.body: The four core colours appear together only in the lanyard strap. Elsewhere a card or row shows at most one track colour, as a small dot inside a chip.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Google Sans Mono sets dates, deadlines, counts and short metadata. Never names, titles, labels or body copy.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are sentence case. No ALL-CAPS mono eyebrows above headings, and no line above the agenda card's title. The small "Idea" or "Proposed" line in a saved-talk row and the "DevFest" or "Meetup" label over a ruler marker are data labels paired with their data, not kickers.

rules.name: The Only Thing That Hangs Rule
rules.body: Only the badge casts a shadow. Panels, cards, strips and rows stay flat and separate by tone. Things that float above the page for a moment (the alert, menus, the dropdown's list) are the exception.

dos: **Do** keep the page Black 02 and build depth from the `#282828` and `#303030` surfaces, not translucent white cards.
**Do** fill solid buttons with the deep variants (Blue 700, Green 700, Red 600) and keep them pills.
**Do** colour agenda status the same everywhere it shows (marker, pill, status line, current step: green, yellow, white) and say the same thing in words.
**Do** give every control boundary at least a 35% white border and every focus a solid Google Blue ring or border (BRANDING.md, Interactive States).
**Do** use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for portal motion, 150 to 300ms for state and 300 to 450ms for panels, and remove travel under reduced motion.
**Do** put field errors under the field and server errors in the bottom-left alert, which stays until dismissed.
**Do** use skeletons shaped like the content they stand in for.
**Do** open dashboard forms in the agenda card's place with the stage morph, never stacked above it.
donts: **Don't** put white text on the core Google colours; they fail AA at button sizes.
**Don't** set names, titles or body copy in Google Sans Mono.
**Don't** add ALL-CAPS mono eyebrows or kickers above headings.
**Don't** use the four core colours together anywhere but the lanyard strap.
**Don't** give panels, cards or rows a shadow; only the badge hangs.
**Don't** tilt or animate a badge that holds a form.
**Don't** drop text below white 50% on Black 02, or below white 60% for text under 14px on `#303030`.
**Don't** use spinners or blank sections while data loads.
